name: rx9070xt
description: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (Navi 48, RDNA 4, gfx1201) at its 2400 MHz game clock: one Vortex core per compute unit (CU).

sources.NUM_CORES: 64 CUs in 4 shader engines (AMD RX 9070 XT specifications; Chips and Cheese, RDNA 4 architecture)
sources.NUM_THREADS, ISSUE_WIDTH, FETCH_WIDTH, N: 2 SIMD32 units per CU, each with its own scheduler, running wave32 at one instruction per clock; 16 waves per SIMD (AMD RDNA 4 ISA; zolotukhin.ai RDNA3/RDNA4 reference)
sources.NUM_ALU_LANES, NUM_FPU_LANES: 32 lanes per SIMD for FP32 and INT32 (VALU). RDNA 4's dual-issue (VOPD) and the paired FP32 rate behind its 48.7 TFLOPS are not modelled: the profile issues one VALU instruction per SIMD per clock
sources.NUM_LSU_LANES, NUM_LSU_BLOCKS: One vector-memory path per CU behind the 32 KB L0 vector cache, which returns 64 B per clock (16 x 4 B lanes)
sources.DCACHE_SIZE: 32 KB L0 vector cache per CU, 64 B lines. RDNA 4 turned the shader-array L1 into a read/write coalescing buffer, so there is no L1 level to model (Chips and Cheese, RDNA 4)
sources.ICACHE_SIZE: 32 KB instruction cache per WGP (two CUs), i.e. 16 KB per CU
sources.LMEM_LOG_SIZE, LMEM_NUM_BANKS: 64 KB LDS per CU in CU mode (128 KB per WGP), 32 banks of 4 B = 128 B per clock per CU; Vortex banks are XLEN wide (8 B), so 16 banks carry the same bytes per clock
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_BANKS: 8 MB L2, 2 MB per shader engine, 128 B lines (Chips and Cheese, RDNA 4); one bank per memory channel; 16 ways as GCN/RDNA L2s
sources.L3_ENABLE, L3_SIZE, L3_NUM_WAYS, L3_NUM_: 64 MB third-generation Infinity Cache (MALL) behind the L2, modelled as the Vortex L3, one bank per memory channel
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_TYPE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_NU: 256-bit GDDR6 at 20 Gbps: 8 devices x 2 x16 channels = 16 channels, 16 x 2 B x 20 GT/s = 640 GB/s; latency not calibrated
sources.EXT_MUFU_ENABLE, NUM_MUFU_LANES: Transcendentals (exp, log, rcp, rsq, sqrt) at a quarter rate per SIMD: 8 per SIMD, 16 per CU per clock
sources.EXT_TCU_ENABLE, TCU_*: Two AI accelerators (WMMA) per CU, one per SIMD as NUM_TCU_BLOCKS=ISSUE_WIDTH: FP16/BF16, FP8/BF8, INT8 and INT4 with 4:2 sparsity; no TF32
sources.VM_ENABLE, EXT_A_ENABLE, EXT_ZACAS_ENABL: GPUVM paging, global and LDS atomics with compare-swap, FP16, workgroup barriers, and the graphics pipeline (4 texture units per CU, rasterizers, ROPs) of a gaming part
sources.xlen: 64-bit machine: 64-bit pointers and FP64. FP64 runs at 1/32 of the dual-issue FP32 rate (4 per CU per clock) on the part; with XLEN=64 every FPU lane executes FP64, so the profile has 64 FP64 lanes per CU
sources.FDIV_PE_RATIO, FSQRT_PE_RATIO: Transcendentals (reciprocal, reciprocal square root, on which division and square root are built) run at a quarter of the FP32 rate on GCN, RDNA and CDNA: FPU lanes / 4
